name: Eating Certain Foods
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign provision and guidance regarding eating certain foods, beginning with His declaration in Genesis 9:3 that all moving creatures and plants are given for human nourishment. The Lord's instructions to Moses and Aaron in Leviticus 11 emphasize divine authority in distinguishing clean and unclean foods. While Deuteronomy 14:1 addresses holiness among God's people, Mark 7:19 clarifies that what enters the body does not defile the heart, underscoring a shift from external dietary laws toward understanding purity in a spiritual sense.
